annotations.title: Brazil Retail Fuel Prices & Biofuel Parity (ANP)

description: Queries real-time audited retail fuel prices across all 27 Brazilian Federative Units (UFs) and 417+ cities from Brazil's National Petroleum Agency (ANP). Covers Regular Gasoline (Gasolina Comum), Additive Gasoline (Gasolina Aditivada), Hydrous Ethanol (Etanol Hidratado), Diesel S10, Diesel S500, and CNG (GNV). Calculates official 70% biofuel economic parity ratio and price dispersion across 5,939 monitored gas stations across all 27 Brazilian states (official ANP weekly audited sample). When to use: Retrieve current station-level and statewide retail fuel prices and ethanol vs gasoline parity in Brazil. When NOT to use: Do NOT use for residential cooking gas LPG prices (use brazil_lpg_gas_prices) or freight transport rates (use brazil_freight_logistics). Read-only and idempotent operation; no authentication required up to 60 req/min.

cidade.description: Optional city name or URL slug (e.g., 'sao-paulo', 'rio-de-janeiro', 'campinas', 'salvador'). Defaults to empty string to return statewide statistics.

combustivel.description: Fuel type filter for price ranking and statistics. Defaults to 'todos'.

uf.description: Two-letter Brazilian state code in lowercase (e.g., 'sp', 'rj', 'mg', 'ba', 'pr', 'ce', 'df'). Call brazil_list_states to see all 27 valid UF codes.

name: brazil_fuel_prices
